title: Best Dog Food (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products that appear in more than one source or are highlighted as top picks. Sources used: Holistic Digest (source 3) and Smart Bark (source 5).
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.

verdict.line: Picture a senior dog eating a meal that tastes like home‑cooked meat and stays healthy. We Feed Raw offers the most nutrient‑dense ingredients and the best value among the tested brands, making it ideal for dogs that need a minimally processed diet. The catch: it requires refrigeration and is not as convenient as dry or subscription options.
